title: pkix-chain uses pkix_path_builder types without re-exporting
description:
In pkix-chain/src/lib.rs, the public Error enum exposes Error::PathBuild(pkix_path_builder::Error) (line 233) and Error::AiaDepthExceeded mentions the AIA_MAX_DEPTH constant. The pkix_path_builder::Error type is part of pkix-chain's public API surface (callers match on Error::PathBuild), but pkix_path_builder is not re-exported from pkix-chain.

What goes wrong: A caller who wants to match on the inner pkix_path_builder::Error must add pkix-path-builder as a direct dependency, and must pin a compatible version. If pkix-chain bumps its pkix-path-builder dependency to a new semver-breaking version, the caller's direct dep version may conflict. The re-export standard says: if crate A's public API uses types from crate B, A should re-export B.

Location: pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:233

Recommendation: Add 'pub use pkix_path_builder;' (or at minimum 'pub use pkix_path_builder::Error as PathBuildError;') to pkix-chain's public API.
